list.text:
No need to hurry.
No need to sparkle.
No need to be anybody but oneself.
list.author: No need to hurry. No need to sparkle. No need to be anybody but oneself.  Virginia Woold "A Room of One's Own" (1929)

list.text: I don't want to not be important.
list.author: Irving Azoff (Eagles Manager)
